brob.definition:
n. A peculiar brad-shaped spike, to be driven alongside the end
   of an abutting timber to prevent its slipping.

brobdingnag.definition: n. a land imagined by Jonathan Swift where everything was enormous
brobdingnag.translation: n. 大人国(出自<<格列佛游记>>)

brobdingnagian.definition: a. huge; relating to or characteristic of the imaginary country of Brobdingnag
brobdingnagian.translation:
n. 巨人
a. 巨大的；大人国的
